edits: add 2,3-difluoro on quinone ring of quinoxaline-5,8-dione
accepted.hypothesis: D05 has the highest f (1.09) but O2 margin is -0.054. D09 shows ring fluorination gives margin +0.178 with f=0.86 and no detachment (K084 F4-BQ binds CO2 strongly, K123 quinoxalinedione binds). Adding F2 to the pyrazine-fused quinone should lift margin above 0.15 while the N-heteroaryl scaffold keeps strong binding, so f may rise toward 2. Avoids CN (D03/D07/D12 detached) and amino/OH (D01/D04/D06 f<-1).

edits: add 2,3-dichloro on quinone ring of quinoxaline-5,8-dione
accepted.hypothesis: Cl substitution raised margin in D08 (0.097) and D18 (0.346) with f staying positive and no detachment. Two Cl on the high-f pyrazine-quinone (D05) should add about 0.15-0.2 V margin, with binding preserved by the N-heterocycle. Cl count is limited to 2 because D08 to D18 to D13 shows f falling as halogen count increases. Cl-quinones also have CO2-adduct and moderate binding evidence (K008, K056).

edits: replace two F with Cl at 2,6 positions (mixed Cl2F2 benzoquinone)
accepted.hypothesis: D09 (F4) meets the margin (0.178) but f is 0.86, and D08 (Cl2, f=1.04) has higher f but lower margin. A mixed Cl2F2 benzoquinone keeps the F-driven margin and borrows the 2,6-Cl pattern that gave higher f. Full per-chloro D18 lost f (0.63), so only two Cl are used. Chloranil and F4-BQ are CO2-adduct formers (K029, K084).

edits: add one F on each pyridine ring of the phenanthroline-dione
accepted.hypothesis: D10 (f=0.56, margin -0.010) beats the carbocyclic analog D21 (f=0.71 vs margin -0.196) on margin, so ring N raises margin without detachment. N placement near the 1,2-dione gives strong binding (-25 kcal-like bind) and K110/K117 show high binding constants for this class. Adding F to the pyridines should withdraw electron density, add roughly 0.15-0.2 V margin, and keep binding; f could reach above 1.

D19, D14 and D05 form a high-f series (0.86-1.09) that all have margin near zero. Aryl groups (D19 margin 0.076, D14 -0.002) do not help much. Swapping them for F on the pyrazine should add electron withdrawal and lift margin above 0.15, and removes the steric bulk that may weaken binding. The quinoxalinedione core has strong measured binding (K124, K123). CN-type detachment is avoided because F is much less withdrawing than CN.
